parts.name: Translation
parts.Basic_description: This is a sliding glass panel of the window, made of transparent glass material.
parts.Functional_description: It allows light to pass through while providing a movable section for ventilation or access.
parts.Movement_description: It can slide horizontally along the window frame for opening and closing.

parts.name: Translation
parts.Basic_description: This is another sliding glass panel of the window, made of glass similar to the first translation part.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a movable section that can slide to open or close the window partially or fully.
parts.Movement_description: It moves horizontally along the track opposite to the other sliding panel.

parts.name: Translation
parts.Basic_description: This is the central glass panel of the window, which may be fixed or slightly adjustable.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a transparent section for visibility and light transmission.
parts.Movement_description: It may remain stationary or have limited sliding capability depending on the window design.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame of the window, made of aluminum for structural support.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the glass panels in place and provides the track for sliding movement.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the structural base for the entire window assembly.
